Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun on her back. One day, she saw a pretty butterfly in the sky. She wanted to catch it, but it flew away.

Lily's mommy said, "Lily, it's not safe to bother yourself instead. Let's ask the bug for a shelter and look at it together." So, Lily and her mommy went to the garden and found some pretty flowers and watered them and waited for them to come.
